tpl: After Chanting for a short time, activates the skill. Consumes 2 Mana every attack, and ATK +{0}. If there are no enemies within range, heals allied operators instead Skill can be manually deactivated

After Chanting for 11s, consumes 35 Mana to create a familiar to attack; ATK +{0}, attacks Slow all targets for 0.5s. Skill can be activated again to upgrade the familiar; attack range +1, ASPD +{1}, attacks Stun the main target for 0.5s Unlimited duration. Skill can be manually deactivated during first activation

After Chanting for 5s, consumes 8 Mana to create an explosion in front of the unit at max range; explosion deals {0} ATK as Arts damage to surrounding enemies and causes high ground tiles to collapse, Stunning them for {1}s Chanting can be extended for 10s; upon completion, consumes all remaining Mana; for every 8 additional Mana consumed, create 1 additional explosion Extended chanting can be manually deactivated
